faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: What people ask most before signing up.

items.q: Why does Tendrik show fewer tenders than other services?
items.a: Other services often quote every tender they've ever recorded – including ones that closed years ago. We only show active tenders you can apply for right now. Expired tenders are removed automatically so you don't have to dig through outdated calls.

items.q: Where does the data come from?
items.a: From official public sources: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily – the EU-wide gazette), the ÚVO gazette (Slovak Public Procurement Office), EKS (Electronic Contracting System) and JOSEPHINE (a below-threshold platform used by cities, hospitals and regions).
Every day we pull new tenders from all four sources and drop the ones past their deadline. In practice you see the current state of what's biddable today.

You get 30 days free to try (including 5 AI tender analyses), then €4.99 / month (Basic, monitoring) or €14.99 / month (Premium with unlimited AI). Final price – Tobify s. r. o. is not a VAT payer. No card required at signup – we'll reach out before the trial ends. Cancel anytime.
Small and medium businesses, tradespeople, IT and construction firms, consultants and service providers – anyone who wants to bid on public tenders without trawling four different portals every day.
